# Treasure › Tokens

> A token is an item of personal significance—such as a memento, heirloom, or individual treasure. Use this table when prompted by the Precious Items (`oracles/treasure/precious-items.md`) table, or to add detail to a character. A token might have intrinsic value, but is often a thing of worth only to its owner. Not all treasures are silver and gold.
>
> Cursed die: on a 10, read the same roll on `oracles/treasure/tokens-cursed.md` instead.
>
